findings: Wellness requires two semesters of duration and at least one semester of movement; source code records cannot be converted to a choose-N course or credit denominator. Context-only profiles do not mean the inventory is missing these rules.
Fixed core remains eight BA and nine BS identities; introductory Python versus Java-plus-Python is a genuine choice, and the reciprocal Java alias does not merge Python or its credit exclusions.

Canonical subject totals are arithmetic over the primary reviewed categories after independently checking role and alias sets. Only the explicitly listed description subset is newly independently reread here.
The coordinator policy/13-pool report and 207 description reads remain separately attributed evidence, not a claim that this reviewer read every underlying description.
remaining: Full independent second reading of all remaining course descriptions and individual category rationales is not complete; no access blocker is inferred from that remaining work.

defects.issue: Generic unresolved-role wording could suggest the 97 documented duration-only wellness identities were missing evidence.
defects.correction: Detail and comparison now state that these records are outside the fixed/option count profiles and refer to individual rules; this also avoids certifying genuinely unresolved or unbound records.
defects.status: corrected; real Case and mixed-context regression coverage

identity_exclusions.reason: Explicit different audience/proficiency progression, notwithstanding reciprocal Offered-as and credit exclusion.
Capstone364C retains different role and prerequisite scope; only non-capstone364/HUMN364 merged. Credit exclusion does not erase versions.
